item.tib: zhi ba g.yung drung don 'dus kyi mngon rtogs dgongs pa'i rgyan
item.coloph: ces pa 'di'ang rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyi ngag las nye bar thon zhing / a yu rdodzas dkar phyogs su phyi mo'i re kha btab pas gsang sems bstan la zhugs pa rnams kyi grub gnyis dga' ston 'byed pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
